quality.notes: Each cell has characterisation curves (1C and pseudo-OCV, charge and discharge) every 100 drive cycles; the drive-cycle waveform itself is only given for the first cycle in ExampleDC_C1.mat. Model (Kokam SLPB533459H4) is named, but no official Kokam datasheet for this exact model could be located publicly (only generic/other SLPB-series documents) - dimensions, cathode chemistry and voltage range left null rather than inferred from the model number's naming convention. Charging profile: the same protocol for all eight cells: a 2C CC-CV charge and an Artemis drive-cycle discharge; the registry also names it Artemis. Only cycle 1 of the ageing cycles is delivered as a time series. The recorded discharge maximum is the observed drive-cycle peak of the delivered first cycle (about -5.0 A, 6.76C of 740 mAh); the characterisation cycles are 1C. The charge rate is 2C (1480 mA). Chemistry: the dataset's Readme.txt names the cells as 8 x Kokam SLPB533459H4, 740 mAh, and tells users to cite Birkl's 2017 DPhil thesis with the dataset; the thesis (Section 2.1) states for its Kokam SLPB 533459H 740 mAh pouch cells a graphite negative electrode and a positive electrode that is a blend of LCO and NCO (lithium nickel cobalt oxide, no Mn or Al named). The thesis model is written SLPB 533459H and the dataset's SLPB533459H4, the same family; the match rests on the model names. The Readme also gives: 1C characterisation 740 mA, pseudo-OCV 40 mA, 2C charge 1480 mA, 40 C chamber, Bio-Logic MPG-205 tester, tests started 2015-01-08. Rate combinations: the ageing charge is 2C CC-CV (readme) against the Artemis drive-cycle discharge (rate group, no pair). Each characterisation block every 100 ageing cycles holds two constant-current cycles with the same rate in both directions, checked in cell 1 at cycles 0 and 100: a 1C (about 740 mA) discharge from 4.19 to 2.70 V followed by a 1C charge to 4.20 V, then about 10 h later a pseudo-OCV discharge and charge at about 40 mA (0.05C). The delivered characterisation charges end at 4.2 V with no current taper, so they are listed as CC; the readme's CC-CV description applies to the ageing charge, whose first-cycle example also shows a constant 1483 mA to 4.2 V with no taper.
